title: ‘Donald Trump feels BETRAYED & MISLED by Benjamin Netanyahu over Iran war quagmire.’
text:
‘Donald Trump feels BETRAYED & MISLED by Benjamin Netanyahu over Iran war quagmire.’"

"—Doug Bandow, Former Special Assistant to President Ronald Reagan"

"‘I don't think that he feels any particular loyalty, for example, to Netanyahu. I suspect he also, in fact, feels betrayed to some degree that Netanyahu promised him an easy win, three or four days, regime change."

"“You can go home and have your big parade and an arch of triumph and you've won.” And none of that happened."

"I think he knows that he was misled, that the question of his political future, to have a Congress heavily dominated by Democrats would be very dangerous for him."

"To have the Republican Party damaged significantly would be bad for him, to have it ruined for the next presidential election."

"All of these things mattered to him. So I suspect that he really knows he's got to get this over. And my hope is that sense of self-preservation takes over very quickly."

"Because if it's just his ego, he really could take the world over the edge."

"But if he worries about his reputation for the future, then there's hope that he might decide he's got to get it done.’"
